description.narrative: On the partner identification study we took the first steps in order to find out how we in the partnership can improve the organizational building of ZeMolodizhka. They are a big youth political organization in Ukraine, but due to the war they are facing several challenges, which means they now are dealing with new issues that they have never been facing before. The importance of creating a strong foundation for ZeMolodizhka is more important than ever, and with a strong future cooperation with several training sessions we have a clear understanding that the leaders and members of ZeMolodizhka can develop a lot and improve their skills in especially organizational building, recruitment and retaining of new members as well as fundraising. The purpose of the pilot project is to educate the regional leaders in how to build a successful organization and equip them in a way, so they easily can teach their own local leaders and members.
